v1.37.3 (24 October 2024) |feed_title = 🎃 The Hexscape Event 🎃 |feed_color = Red |previous_update = [[v1.36.0]] |next_update = [[v1.38.0|Hexscape Night II Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.37.0''' is the ninetieth update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 23rd of October 2024. This update was also given the name '''Hexscape Update''', as this update added the [[Hexscape Event]]. This update encompassed four updates, the main v1.37.0 update (released 23 October 2024) and three minor updates, the v1.37.1 (released 23 October 2024), the v1.37.2 (released 23 October 2024) the v1.37.3 (released 24 October 2024). ==Additions== ===Consumables=== *[[Turkey Leg]] *[[Pumpkin Bomb]] *[[Sugar Rush (Consumable)|Sugar Rush]] ===Enemies=== *[[Quick Pawn]] *[[Pawn]] *[[Brain Bound]] *[[Mind Shackled]] *[[Neuro Runner]] *[[Synaptic]] *[[Titus]] ===Maps=== *[[Failed Gateway]] ===Skins=== *{{Color|Hexscape|King of Rock}} [[Scout]] *{{Color|Hexscape|Aerobics}} [[Soldier]] *{{Color|Hexscape|Dance Fever}} [[Shotgunner]] *{{Color|Hexscape|Frankenstein}} [[Ranger]] *{{Color|Hexscape|Wasteland}} [[Militant]] *{{Color|Hexscape|Wasteland}} [[Military Base]] *{{Color|Hexscape|Road Rage}} [[Minigunner]] *{{Color|Hexscape|Wasteland}} [[Commander]] *{{Color|Hexscape|Freddy}} [[Warden]] *{{Color|Hexscape|Wasteland}} [[Farm]] *{{Color|Hexscape|Disco}} [[Accelerator]] *{{Color|Hexscape|Garage Band}} [[DJ Booth]] ===Emotes=== *[[Scarecrow (Emote)|Scarecrow]] *[[Quota Craze]] *[[Scary Coffin]] *[[The Worm]] *[[Moon Walk]] *[[Take The L]] *[[Bumper Cart]] *[[Broomstick]] ===Stickers=== *[[Angry Pumpkin]] *[[Narrator (Sticker)|Narrator]] *[[Umbra Laugh]] *[[MJ Hehe]] ===Miscellanous=== *[[Hexscape Event]] *{{CandyCorns|Candy Corn Currency}} *New lobby *Catalog button **Allows players to equip catalog items. *[[Settings#Health Bar Color|Health Bar Color]] setting. *[[Settings#HQ Effects|HQ Effects]] setting. *[[Settings#Cutscene|Cutscenes]] sound setting. *[[Dispatcher]] narrator *[[Titus (Narrator)|Titus]] narrator :In '''v1.37.3''' *Capture Button **Part of [[w:c:roblox:The Haunt|The Haunt]] event. ==Changes & Bugfixes== ===Towers=== *[[Slasher]] reworked. **[[Slasher]] now applies a bleed debuff to enemies. ***This stacks with every hit, only dealing damage when it is not being dealt damage. Explodes upon reaching max stacks. ***Damage is based on an enemy's max health, using the '''Slasher's''' base bleed damage and EV. **''Knife Throw'' removed. **Now deals critical hits every third hit. Boosted damage depends on the critical damage multiplier. **Placement limit of 12 added. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|450}} to {{Money|1,500}}. ****Swingrate decreased from 0.575 to 0.425. ****''Knife Throw'' and all statistics related to it removed. ****Damage increased from 3 to 6. ****Crit multiplier of 2.5 added. ***'''Level 1''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|350}} to {{Money|800}}. ****Swingrate changed from {{Tooltip|0.575 > 0.425|-0.15}} to {{Tooltip|0.425 > 0.375|-0.05}}. ****Damage decreased from +1 to +0. ****Hidden detection added, moved from Level 2 to Level 1. ****Renamed from ''Fast Fingers'' to ''Sleight of Hand''. ***'''Level 2''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|850}} to {{Money|3,500}}. ****Range decreased from +1 to +0.5. ****Damage increased from +2 to +14. ****Swingrate changed from 0.425 to {{Tooltip|0.375 > 0.725|+0.35}}. ****Gains bleed debuff. *****Max stacks of 30. *****Bleed stack of 1 added. ***'''Level 3''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|2,350}} to {{Money|7,000}}. ****Damage increased from +4 to +25. ****Swingrate changed from {{Tooltip|0.425 > 0.325|-0.1}} to {{Tooltip|0.725 > 0.625|-0.1}}. ****Crit multiplier increase of +0.5 added. ****''Renamed from ''Knife Party'' to ''Swords Dance''. ***'''Level 4''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|7,500}} to {{Money|20,000}}. ****Range decreased from +1 to +0.5. ****Damage increased from +14 to +15. ****Swingrate changed from 0.325 to {{Tooltip|0.625 > 0.525|-0.1}}. ****Bleed stack increase of +1 added. ****Crit multiplier increase of +0.5 added. ****Renamed from ''Contract Killer'' to ''Serial Killer''. *[[Slasher]] is now available through a limited time gamepass for {{Robux|749}}. *[[Mercenary Base]] rebalanced. **Placement limit is now 3 regardless of player count. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****[[Rifleman]] limit of 10 added. ****[[Grenadier]] limit of 7 added. ****[[Riot Guard]] limit of 4 added. ****[[Field Medic]] limit of 3 added. ****Level 0 [[Rifleman]] now has a lifespan of 150. ***'''Level 2''' ****Level 0 [[Grenadier]] now has a lifespan of 180. ***'''Level 3''' ****Level 1 [[Rifleman]] now decreases a lifespan ****[[Golden Tommy Goon 2|Golden Body Guard]] lifespan of 100 added. *Units that stop moving to attack enemies, such as [[Tommy Goon 1|Tommy Goon]]s or [[Rifleman]], now need to find space that is not currently occupied by other units to stop moving. *Fixed {{Color|Lunar|Masquerade}} [[Medic]] animations breaking at Level 5. :In '''v1.37.2''': *Fixed [[Accelerator]] having incorrect statistics. ===Maps=== :In '''v1.37.2a''': *Reduced [[Failed Gateway]] Easy {{Exp|}} and {{Coins|Coins}} rewards. *Reduced [[Failed Gateway]] Hard {{Coins|Coins}} rewards, increased {{Exp|}} rewards. *Fixed cutscesnes not working in [[Failed Gateway]]. :In '''v1.37.3''': *Decreased [[Failed Gateway]] {{Coins|Coins}} rewards. *Fixed [[HP Locked]] boosting rewards in [[Failed Gateway]]. ===Emotes=== *Fixed [[Axe Throw]] emote not throwing its axe. ===Stickers=== :In '''v1.37.1''': *Fixed [[Hexscape Event]] stickers not being claimed. ===Miscellanous=== *Updated UI. **Tower loadout now uses the same UI as during matches. **Moved buttons at the bottom of the screen to the right side. **{{Coins|Coins}} and {{Gem|Gems}} are now listed on the right instead of the top. **Added [[Party]] members next to the play survival button. **[[Robux Shop]] gamepasses section now has two larger displays at the top. **[[Rewards]] no longer displays information about [[Passes|Seasons]] and map triumphs. **[[Matchmaking]] icon at the top of the match type selection now uses the party icon. **User invite UI for parties changed, now it displays users in boxes instead of a list. Additionally, if there is no one to invite, friends will be displayed instead. **Updated [[Levels|level]] UI. **Updated base health bar and all information listed alongside it. **Wave text now changes color at the final wave. ***{{Color|2f7341|Dark Green}} in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode. ***{{Color|f0c300|Yellow}} in [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode. ***{{Color|284857|Blue}} in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. ***{{Color|9400D3|Purple}} in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. ***{{Color|ff0000|Red}} in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode, events and special maps. **Overhauled [[Passes|Seasons]] UI, now called [[Seasons|Battle Passes]]. **Overhauled news feed UI. **Some unit lifespans are now displayed under their health. **Updated mobile buttons. **Modifier icons will not move to a different row if the row becomes too long. **Improved keybinds UI. **Fixed multiple issues with the mobile UI layout. *Changed [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode triumph bonus rewards. **{{Color|Uncommon}} rewards now also include the [[Turkey Leg]] (1-2) and [[Pumpkin Bomb]] (1-2). **{{Color|Rare}} rewards now also include the [[Sugar Rush (Consumable)|Sugar Rush]] (1-2). *Changed [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode triumph bonus rewards. **{{Color|Uncommon}} rewards now also include the [[Turkey Leg]] (1-3) and [[Pumpkin Bomb]] (1-2). **{{Color|Rare}} rewards now also include the [[Sugar Rush (Consumable)|Sugar Rush]] (1-2). *Changed [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode triumph bonus rewards. **{{Color|Uncommon}} rewards now also include the [[Turkey Leg]] (1-3) and [[Pumpkin Bomb]] (1-2). **{{Color|Rare}} rewards now also include the [[Sugar Rush (Consumable)|Sugar Rush]] (1-2). *Updated UI sounds. *Updated [[Elevators|elevator]] look. **Planes can now be seen in the sky when players teleport into matches. **Entering and leaving [[Elevators]] no longer allows the player to quickly change the map in the [[Elevators|elevator]]. **Entering an [[Elevators|elevator]] now teleports the entire party into it. *Improved console support. **Battle pass now can be opened with {{XboxButton|b}}/{{PSButton|circle}} in the lobby. **Catalog now can be opened with {{XboxButton|y}}/{{PSButton|triangle}} in the lobby. **Main [[Matchmaking]] menu now can be opened with {{XboxButton|x}}/{{PSButton|square}} in the lobby. **Left stick is now used to run. **D-pad can no longer be used to move in some menus, now its only the right stick or the game menu toggle. **D-pad up now opens/closes the sticker wheel, previously nothing could open it. **D-pad down now opens/closes the emote wheel, previously nothing could open it. **D-pad right now opens/closes the leaderboards. **{{XboxButton|a}}/{{PSButton|cross}} can now be used to select more things, such as map overriding, though the {{XboxButton|right trigger}}/{{PSButton|r2}} can still be used for some actions. **{{XboxButton|left trigger}}/{{PSButton|l2}} can now be used to swap hotbars. **{{XboxButton|left trigger}}/{{PSButton|l2}} can now be used to rotate towers. **Towers can no longer be upgraded using {{XboxButton|a}}/{{PSButton|cross}}. **Towers can no longer be sold using {{XboxButton|x}}/{{PSButton|square}}. **Selecting a tower no longer makes the camera move around it. Changing selected tower with left stick is also now no longer possible *Updated loading screen to be Halloween themed. *Towers now rotate by 45 degrees instead of 90 degrees. *[[Blood]] modifier updated. *Blood is now green for players under the age of 13. *[[XP Boost]] description changed from "''It's the weekend! You will get double the experience.''" to "''Enjoy a boost to your earned EXP!''". *Optimized the cutscene system. *Server size decreased from 45 to 30 in the lobby. *Dialog with voice acting now lowers background music volume. *Automatically moved all unclaimed [[Passes|Seasons]] rewards to the [[Gift Box]]. *Dialogue is now affected by [[Time Scale]]. *Fixed [[Towers]] not having animations on the Triumph screen, as all of them except [[Ace Pilot]] and [[Gatling Gun]] were broken. *Fixed [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] narrator using an outdated model. *Fixed inventory, veto and start buttons not disappearing when in the inventory. *Fixed [[Settings#Bullet Trails|Bullet Trails]] setting not working. *Fixed [[Settings#Show Tower Pets|Show Tower Pets]] and [[Settings#Equip Tower Pets|Equip Tower Pets]] settings not appearing. *Fixed consumable accessories. *Fixed tower boundary circles. *Fixed players in chat that are verified no longer have double checkmarks. :In '''v1.37.1''': *Fixed door to the [[Hexscape Event]] not opening. :In '''v1.37.2''': *Disabled revives. :In '''v1.37.3''': *Fixed premium battle pass gifting not working correctly. ==Official Update Trailer== [[File:The Hexscape Trailer (HALLOWEEN) - Tower Defense Simulator|750px|thumb|center]] ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} HexscapeNight1Thumbnail.png TheHauntThumbnail.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} HexscapeEventCountdownIcon.png HexscapeNight1Icon.png TheHauntIcon.png {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} V1.37.0Render.png }} ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate, as this is transcribed from the in-game update log.
